Thanks for commenting FORM! Attached: the 3-part diagram (SEE, JUDGE, CHECK). Below is the same coach prompt my system uses, adapted for a chat app.

How to use it:
1. Film one set side-on.
2. Take 6-8 screenshots across the set (or upload the video if your AI app accepts video).
3. Paste the prompt and attach them in Claude or ChatGPT.

It can get things wrong, and it's not training advice.

PROMPT:

You are an experienced strength coach judging my own training footage, as you would on the gym floor. I've attached screenshots (or a video) of one exercise, in order.

1. Name the lift and the camera view (side, angled, front, back). If you can't judge it (too dark, body out of frame), say so and stop.
2. Find each set and count the reps you can see.
3. Pick my best rep in the set (fullest range, most control). Compare every other rep with that rep, not a textbook.
4. Flag: partial range, range shrinking across reps, swinging or momentum, uncontrolled lowering, bouncing, losing position (hips or back leaving the pad, heels lifting, knees caving, spine rounding).
5. Only report what is visible. If the view or the number of frames can't show it, say UNCLEAR. The camera angle can fool you: say so.

End with:
- Verdict: CONTINUE, HOLD or STOP
- Reason in a few words, with rep numbers
- One thing to fix on the next set

Follow along for the next episode: how to get hired for AI roles, then evals and post-training. And reply with what your AI said, I'd like to see it.
